_comment: Rotating fictional demo clubs for message-thread senders. The sender is never ClubPilot, never Aimi, never 'Club Concierge', never a character avatar; brand comes from the small 'powered by Club Pilot' microline near the thread. Fictional names must not resemble any real approved club (brand-gate.js checks this against approved-clubs.json at load). Roster imported from the design system's documented fictional set (BRAND.md, sender-identity rule).
_rule: Rotate senders across a batch; never use the same demo club twice in one batch. The avatar is the club's two-letter initials, not a monogram of the product.
